subject: Republishing application to shinyapps has no action in RStudio

messages.author: 6bc4e5c52ecb6567
messages.subject: Republishing application to shinyapps has no action in RStudio
parts:
Having published an application, I now cannot update it from within RStudio

My workflow is

Run Shiny App
Press "Republish" in the viewer window
In the Publish to Server dialog press "Publish"

All goes very quiet.
